book.name: Matai
book.title: Yesu Kalisi-te banye nivasa lohvu Matai kaavu

content: Yesu ninaavi ango yoow ak
Busin namaavaalu vindak ti la vêêl e, mem Yesu hako Pita yuuh Jems having hali Jon-ambe sil oo lalak kandu bopaata ti be lala.

+ o 17:2 2Pi 1:16-18*Tombe sil pin-ambe daale, tonde sim Yesu ninaavi ango yoow ak hôôk yaal amend, de mekaalus tum bop nambe taaku me, tombe yite lolop ayuuh ame yoo nivalôôy lôôt nambe bayiimb ahevalôôy.
Tombe sim yaal layi de Mose yuuh Eliya daale dakaas having Yesu,
tombe Pita nêêl vu Yesu nambe, “Omaaho Bop, yiiy nandôô-jo nivasa lôôt, om naambe gawiingin ond sa daav numang daka yaal mandôô-jo, gate ti, Mose-te ti, de Eliya-te ti.”

+ o 17:5 Saam 2:7; Ais 42:1; Mat 3:17; Mak 1:11; Luk 3:22; Diu 18:15*Naahen nanêêl atonde layi de bayiimb ti têêlang lôôt-ambe vayum sil, tombe lava ti laam hôôk bayiimb-anju lopayo nambe, “Sa Noongg-anja. Sahengg having yi lôôt osin sahengg anivasa vu yi, om ham gango lava.”
Maanggêêm-aso langoyin vakasin-anju, tombe yaal lato pataav baambund neep voon de layêênin lôôt,
tombe Yesu la hambe nama lak yaal, de nêêl nambe, “Maal kandi. Maal-ame anjêênin e.”
Tombe yaal amend velak, le me-layi omaaho ti le, malis, yik Yesu yoo timu naale.

+ o 17:9 Mat 16:20*Tombe sil vu kanduu-ju be daahen mondaluus, tombe Yesu vu kôôvu yaal nambe, “Taahu taahu sen maal ahêê-to ond maal-ame naanêêl vu omaaho ti le, de Omaahonôôn Noow kandi jak naah vu hil yimbin-ate vêêl e mem.”
+ o 17:10 Mal 4:5*Tombe maanggêêm-aso lalingin yi nambe, “Nambe vaati sen tanasin dangga-so danêêl nambe Eliya le naamunggin, le mem omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt-ato naam?”
Le nêêl laah nambe, “De. Eliya le naamunggin in samu va pin dukanaah.

+ o 17:12 Mat 11:14; 14:10*Le sa naanêêl vu ham naambe Eliya laam lung la, le hil-ame lalak ni le, malis. Hil oo dawiing va nindanjeen vu yi lohvu sil oo kand, om yik le lambu nivaane vu Omaahonôôn Noow naambêênju gaving.”
+ o 17:13 Luk 1:17*Yesu nêêl nambêênju tombe mem yite maanggêêm-aso lalak ni nambe nêêl vakasin-anju lak Jon sen nalipis hil-ato.
Yesu hatiiy mamu nipaya hato la in unoopasiv ti be nivasa lak
Latok lala vu hil ngeeyaata tombe omaaho ti la hatung kaatu vu Yesu
de nêêl nambe, “Omaaho Bop, gakam pasiv in sa noongg in baando nasi be nango nivaane bopaata. Nalupake be nayêês kin osin nalukala bel balon ngeeyaata,
tombe sa hako laam vu gate maanggêêm-aso le me-lalohvu nambe lambiing-ambe nivasa jak e.”

+ o 17:17 Diu 32:5,20; Jon 14:9*Tombe Yesu nêêl laah nambe, “Ham hil anipaya, ham-ame awii-having e. Sa mando gaving ham-ambe naangelis e mem ham anjak sate kul ani? De sa gako nimeen in ham na nohvu busin vilis e? Ham gako naam vu sa.”
Tombe Yesu nêêl mamu nipaya be hato la in unoopasiv tii-ju de baando nasii-to lung la pavis-ande nivasa lak.
+ o 17:19 Mat 10:1*Tonde mem Yesu having yite maanggêêm-aso be sil oo dando, tombe maanggêêm-aso lalingin nambe, “Nambe vaati sen hey-ame aalohvu nambe gatiiy mamu nipayaa-ju na le?”

+ o 17:20 Mat 21:21; Mak 11:23; Luk 17:6; 1Ko 13:2*Le Yesu nêêl vu sil nambe, “Ham-ame awii-having niwêêk e, ondeey ham-ame alohvu le. Sa naanêêl keen vu ham naambe ham ambiing gaving pasivdaka nohvu môônd nôôvoow, ond mem ham naanêêl vu kandu tii-ju naambe, ‘Okandi jak-ambe gana baale nganju,’ ond le na. Om naambe ham ambiing gaving ond mem ham alohvu nambe ham e ambiing va pin.
[Lohakin osin yanjakin yiiy in vanôôn in nambe yame angga le de yaanohak amu, ond vaa-jo mu ond mem lohvu nambe gatiiy mamu na, de vaheey ond me-lohvu le.”]
Yesu nêêl balon ango having nambe le jimb-ande kandi jak naah
Yesu having yite maanggêêm-aso be sil ahondoos oo motatuuvu mop Galili, tombe nêêl vu sil nambe, “Le lambu Omaahonôôn Noow dukana hil namand,
+ o 17:23 Mat 16:21*tombe le lanyiis-ambe jimb, tonde busin yaal vêêl e mem kandi jak jesin naah.” Tombe maanggêêm-aso londpayo nimeen lôôt.
Yesu haate taakis Anutu-te dumb bop-ate
+ o 17:24 Eks 30:13; 38:26*Latok lala Kapenaum, tombe hil sen dako taakis Anutu-te dumb bop-atêêto ond lala lalingin Pita nambe, “Mak hamate kaputung naate taakis dumb-ate having a?”

Tombe Pita liinggis nambe, “Êê-e, naate.” Tonde Pita lukala bayêên alo, tombe Yesu nêêl Pita-te vakasin sen la in nambe naanêêl-ato langaah laah lak yi nambe, “Simon, gakam vu nambe vaati? Hil alulemak vu voon-anja dako taakis kupak osin omaahonôôn-atêêto vu laheey? Mak yoo dako vu silate hil a? Me, dako vu hil vaalu?”
Tombe Pita nêêl laah nambe, “Dako vu hil vaalu.” Tombe Yesu nêêl nambe, “Êê-e, om silate hil dando mu. Tombe yik dumb-anju ond Aamangg oote dumb,

lemu wame aambiing-ambe sil ahend kalin jak e, om gana gaate pang dokana betum, tombe paahuung ti dôôk nyendoos ond onggapok avi, tombe gale naatovu mone ti neep hôôk, mem onggako monêê-ja be gana gaate naatu wanêêngg taakis.”
